parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes universal birth-sex exposure: passport/document mismatch can lead to refusal and fraud investigation, facilities and shelters are birth-sex only, prison placement is by birth sex, and Tennessee-style drag/indecent-exposure laws carry jail and felony repeat penalties with a documented trespass arrest. State kills/panic defence and lack of state GI hate-crime protection worsen recourse, though functioning courts have enjoined some measures, national hate-crime and employment protections exist, and no execution pathway is documented. For a minor, care bans, school outing, and facility rules add exposure. Severity if outed is imprisonment and custody harm, not merely exclusion, placing this below 0.35 anchors.

entry_documents.exposure: National passport X/birth-sex policy; discrepancy can trigger refusal and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility. State birth-certificate and licence changes effectively closed since 1977/2023.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, limited waiver, never automatic; civil-liberties litigation ongoing.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry interacts with police/facility checks and can cascade into detention or exclusion.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2026 law mandates prison placement by birth sex; national immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary, sexual abuse for trans men. Trespass arrest led to 24h in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts have enjoined some national orders; pretrial release occurred in documented arrest; no documented remedy for birth-sex placement.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Facility trespass arrest can lead to birth-sex custody; immigration detention compounds harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: State 2026 law requires facilities matching birth sex, bars trans women from women's shelters; 2019 law defines trans bathroom use as indecent exposure (enforcement not sourced).
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29+ states have no mapped ban, but this state does; signage requirement struck down; school bathroom litigation ongoing.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Birth-sex facility rule plus trespass criminalisation in some states creates universal exposure for every visitor.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care under 18, upheld June 2025, with civil penalties for assisting minors and $25,000 provider actions; inmate care banned 2024.
care_services.protection: Adult routine care not documented as banned; some national orders blocked/enjoined, status uncertain.
care_services.interaction: Minor traveller or trans parent/guardian faces care denial; emergency ward placement by documents may out visitor.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Drag ban defines adult cabaret including male/female impersonators, up to 11m29d first offence, 1-6yr felony repeat, upheld on appeal. National counterterrorism strategy labels 'radically pro-transgender' groups for prioritisation.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Drag law was initially held vague; separate suit ongoing; national speech protections and injunctions partially operate.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Vague impersonator language plus police discretion can turn public presence into criminal exposure.

minors_guardians.exposure: Care ban for minors, school birth-sex facilities/sports, May 2024 law requires outing students requesting different name/pronouns to parents; national EO directs prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: School directive preliminarily enjoined in state 2022; sports and bathroom litigation ongoing, outcomes unresolved.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling family risks school-like outing, care interruption, and guardian penalties if seeking care.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Reports of discrimination, refusal, beatings; gay/trans panic defence remains; 7.8/100k killing figure is stated undercount floor and under rubric 16 cannot be used as rate evidence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers GI; state AG 2019 opinion allows enhancement for gender bias, but state hate-crime law does not list GI.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Panic defence and thin state recourse reduce deterrence/prosecution if assault occurs.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No statewide employment/housing/public-accommodations protection; local ordinances preempted for private employers; remedies slow and uncertain for facility, drag and custody harms.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National employment ruling, hate-crime statute, legal clinics, courts enjoining some orders, ombuds/legal-aid passport FAQ.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Protections are partial and litigated; they do not cancel enforced birth-sex facility, shelter, prison or drag rules.

anchor_checks.comparison: Very similar: birth-sex prison housing, criminalised gender presentation, brief sentences, no execution, slow remedies. This case adds US court injunctions and national protections, slightly above, but same tier-1 custody/facility exposure.

Higher risk than 0.35: 0.35 exclusion/humiliation without imprisonment; here documented trespass jail, drag felony, birth-sex prison/shelters, and entry fraud risk make imprisonment credible if outed.

Materially below 0.55: 0.55 ward placement delays care without criminal penalties; here facilities are criminalised, drag performance is felony on repeat, and custody placement is statutory birth-sex.

parsed.synthesis: Protections (enjoinable orders, national hate-crime/employment law, litigation) are real but do not operate against the core exposures: birth-sex facilities/shelters/prisons, document mismatch at entry, and enforceable drag criminalisation. Interaction is cascading—document discrepancy to secondary screening, facility trespass to birth-sex custody, minor care ban to guardian liability. No execution pathway, functioning courts and partial remedies keep rating above 0.15-0.25 extremes, but tier-1 universal exposures and credible jail dominate, yielding ~0.30.
